name: Exp_BvsB
summary: This EA uses the BvsB (Bears vs Bulls) custom indicator to generate trading signals based on crossover logic between the indicator line and its signal line. It opens buy positions when the indicator crosses below the signal line from above, and sell positions when it crosses above from below, with configurable position sizing, stop loss, and take profit. The EA supports multiple smoothing methods and applied price types through the SmoothAlgorithms library.
summary_zh: 该EA使用BvsB（空头vs多头）自定义指标，基于指标线与信号线的交叉逻辑生成交易信号。当指标线从上方穿越信号线时开多仓，从下方穿越时开空仓，支持可配置的仓位管理、止损和止盈。通过SmoothAlgorithms库支持多种平滑方法和适用价格类型。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是BvsB指标的交叉信号交易，属于动量反转类型策略。入场条件为：当指标线(Ind)在上一根K线高于信号线(Sign)且当前K线指标线低于等于信号线时，触发买入信号；反之当指标线在上一根K线低于信号线且当前K线指标线高于等于信号线时，触发卖出信号。出场条件依赖止损和止盈的固定点数设置，同时支持基于信号反向的平仓（BUY_Close/SELL_Close）。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金、亏损后余额或固定手数五种模式。资金管理委托给TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数处理。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，并设置了Deviation参数控制滑点容忍度。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is crossover signal trading based on the BvsB indicator, which falls under the momentum/reversal category. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the indicator line (Ind) was above the signal line (Sign) on the previous bar and crosses to below-or-equal on the current bar; conversely, a sell signal triggers when Ind was below Sign and crosses above-or-equal. Exit conditions rely on fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points, while also supporting signal-based position closing (BUY_Close/SELL_Close when the opposite signal appears). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, or fixed lot size. Money management is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades, and includes a Deviation parameter to control slippage tolerance.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling lot size or ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode: free margin/balance/free margin minus floating P&L/balance minus floating P&L/fixed lot

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 指标计算所用价格类型
parameters.description_en: Price type used for indicator calculation

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号检测的K线索引位置

pros: 支持多种平滑算法（10种），策略灵活性强，可适应不同市场条件
使用IsNewBar机制防止同一K线重复开仓，避免过度交易
买入和卖出的开仓与平仓操作可独立开关控制，策略配置灵活
支持5种仓位管理模式，满足不同风险偏好的资金管理需求
有Recount机制确保指标数据获取失败时重试，增强鲁棒性
pros_en: Supports 10 smoothing algorithms, providing strong flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar, avoiding overtrading
Buy and sell open/close operations can be independently toggled, offering flexible strategy configuration
Supports 5 position sizing modes to accommodate different risk preferences in money management
Recount mechanism ensures retry on indicator data fetch failure, improving robustness
cons: 止损和止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动性（ATR），在不同波动环境下风险不一致
缺少持仓检查，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
没有点差过滤机制，在大幅点差时仍可能开仓，增加交易成本
依赖自定义指标BvsB和外部库，增加了部署和调试的复杂度
SignalBar=1为默认值意味着使用已完成K线信号，但在IsNewBar条件中也允许SignalBar=0即实时信号，可能导致信号不稳定
cons_en: Fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points do not account for market volatility (ATR), leading to inconsistent risk across varying volatility environments
Lacks position checking before opening new trades, potentially leading to duplicate positions in the same direction
No spread filter mechanism, may open positions during wide spreads, increasing trading costs
Depends on custom BvsB indicator and external libraries, increasing deployment and debugging complexity
SignalBar=1 as default uses completed bar signals, but the condition also allows SignalBar=0 for real-time signals which may be unstable
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈功能，根据市场波动自动调整止损止盈距离
添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同向重复开仓，并可加入最大持仓数量限制
增加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，避免在高点差和非活跃时段交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic StopLoss/TakeProfit to automatically adjust distance based on market volatility
Add position checking logic to avoid duplicate same-direction trades and implement maximum position limits
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during wide spreads and inactive periods

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查，可能同向重复开仓导致仓位过重
固定止损止盈未适配市场波动性，低波动时止损过宽浪费利润，高波动时止损过窄容易被扫
没有点差过滤，高点差环境下交易成本不可控
risk_points_en: Lacks position checking, potentially opening duplicate same-direction positions leading to overexposure
Fixed SL/TP does not adapt to market volatility — too wide in low volatility wasting profit, too narrow in high volatility getting stopped out easily
No spread filter means trading costs are uncontrolled in wide spread environments
